name: iPhone 16 Pro Max
review: The most refined iPhone camera system yet, paired with the smoothest display Apple has shipped. Battery finally matches the ambition.

name: iPhone 16
review: Almost all the Pro's smarts in a lighter body — the sensible pick unless you shoot a lot of zoom.

name: iPhone 15
review: Still a superbly built phone a year later, though the Dynamic Island is starting to feel like the base tier's only flex.

name: MacBook Pro 16" M4
review: Silent under sustained loads that make other laptops throttle, with a battery that shrugs off a full workday.

name: MacBook Air 15" M3
review: Fanless, featherlight, and fast enough for almost everyone — still the laptop we recommend most.

name: Asus ROG Zephyrus G14
review: Genuine gaming power in a 14-inch chassis that doesn't scream 'gaming laptop.' Fan noise ramps up fast under load.

name: Asus Zenbook 14 OLED
review: A gorgeous OLED panel and all-day battery life for well under flagship pricing. Speakers are the weak point.

name: Acer Predator Helios 16
review: Serious frame rates at a price that undercuts the competition, if you can live with the bulk and the fan whine.

name: Acer Swift Go 14
review: The budget productivity laptop we keep recommending to students — solid keyboard, middling webcam.

name: Apple Watch Series 10
review: Thinner case, brighter always-on display, and the health tracking suite that still leads the category.

name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
review: Built for multi-day expeditions, priced like it — titanium case, huge battery, dive-rated toughness.

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 7
review: The strongest Wear OS option for Android owners, with sleep coaching that's genuinely useful.

name: AirPods Pro 3
review: Noise cancellation that finally rivals over-ear rivals, plus a fit that stays comfortable for hours.

name: AirPods Max
review: Reference-quality sound and build in a headphone that's heavier — and pricier — than it needs to be.

name: AirPods 4
review: The everyday earbud for iPhone owners who don't need ANC. Case is smaller, fit is better than ever.

name: Apple TV 4K (3rd Gen)
review: The slickest streaming box interface around, though the price still stings next to a $30 dongle.

name: Samsung Neo QLED QN90D
review: Mini-LED brightness that makes HDR genuinely pop, with the best anti-glare coating we've tested.

name: LG OLED C4
review: Perfect blacks, near-instant response time, and the gaming features enthusiasts actually want. Risk of burn-in remains.

name: Sony Bravia XR A80L
review: Sony's color science and motion processing are still unmatched — the remote and smart-TV software are not.
